NATIONAL WATER SUPPLY AND DRAINAGE BOARD ACT, No. 02 OF 1974
Order under Section 92

BY virtue of the powers vested in me, under Section 92 of the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act, No.02 of1974, I, Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply, do hereby approve the acquisition of theimmovable property, described in the following Schedule as it is required by the National Water Supply and DrainageBoard, for the construction of Degaldoruwa Service Reservoir, Pump-house and Access Road and to lay the Pipeline ofKundasale - Haragama Water Supply Project.
RAUFF HAKEEM,Minister of City Planning andWater Supply.Ministry of City Planning and Water Supply,No. 35,New Parliament Road,Pelawatta, Battaramulla,17th August, 2017.5/2/1/1275SCHEDULE

Eight allotments of land called Pethigalawatte and Napanegedarawatte and in total extent of about 128 perchessituated at village of Yakgahapitiya in No. 659, Deekirimadawala Grama Niladhari Division in the Divisional Secretary’sDivision of Kundasale in Kandy District and bounded as follows :—
1. Lot No. 01 - Name of the land -Pethigalawatta, Extent - 46 perches
North by:Land claimed by Mr. I. M. Indrarathne ;East by:By road from Yakgahapitiya Main Road ;South by:Sirimalwatta Yakgahapitiya Menikhinna Road ;West by:Land claimed by Mrs. Indrani Perera.
Name and address of the claimant: 1.Mr. I. M. Indrarathne58, Amunugama,Gunnepana.

ERRATA

BY virtue of the powers vested in me, by Section 92 of the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act, No.02 of the1974, I, Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply, published an order in page 2A of theGazette Extraordinary No. 1922/30 dated 08.07.2015 of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka, the Scheduleto which mentions the name of the land as “Thawalantenna Watta” which, I hereby declare, should be corrected to read as“Kodamadiththa Pathana” as depicted in the progressive trace No. B/HLE/2016/409 prepared by the Survey Department.
